    How to play

    Grenades smash crates and break cracked fences. Jumping clears low shots, shockwaves and gaps, and you can't be hit mid-dash. Bark Wave knocks enemies back and wipes nearby shots once its meter fills. Salvage turns a free weapon or gadget you don't want into XP for your weapon.

    Defeating enemies levels up your weapon; each level lets you pick an upgrade. Picking up a different weapon feeds your current one into it: it keeps 70% of the levels and its upgrades, re-imagined for the new weapon. A weapon holds 4 upgrade types (each up to Lv 6) and Schiffy 8 passives (each up to Lv 5), and weapons top out at Lv 30: doubling up levels one up, and taking something new when full replaces one (the new one starts at Lv 1). Eggs hatch into pets as you clear isles; finish a level with one to add it to your collection.
